summary: Define optional declared admission metadata in kernel and client models without enforcement

replay.detail: Agent and mission declaration models retain optional declared priority, lane and budgets. Absence preserves prior canonical serialization and hashes; no backfill is required.

schema.detail: Client-v0 schemas and generated clients define an optional nonnullable declared_admission group. No claim kind, table, index, storage version or migration is added.

rules.detail: These are data definitions only; scheduling, admission, process priority and resource limits are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Kernel enums and tolerant TypeScript codecs retain unknown future priority and lane values; strict TypeScript codecs reject them. Historical declarations without metadata retain their previous serialized bytes and hashes.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart only; no storage migration or backfill.

manual.detail: This schema-only change does not enable declaration authoring or enforce budgets. ST_SEAT_PRIORITY behavior is unchanged.

recovery.detail: Older readers may discard added typed fields or refuse mission hashes. Remove metadata through upgraded readers before reverting a fleet that has declarations containing it.
